title: Server: add most-active-city aggregate endpoint
Web: fix premature empty-state flash on the date rail
description:
Confirmed root cause of P0-1 ("today's games" rail flashing 'לא נמצאו משחקים בתאריך...' before cards load): `useGamesByDate` (next_app/src/hooks/useGamesByDate.ts:12) initializes `const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);`. The fetch effect (lines 41-90) does `if (!isLoaded) return;` before calling `setLoading(true)` -- so between mount and Clerk's `isLoaded` becoming true, `loading` is `false` and `games` is `[]`. The consumer, `GamesByDateClient.tsx:129-182`, renders the skeleton only `if (loading)` (line 129) and the Hebrew empty-state message otherwise (line 155 `currentDayGames.length === 0`) -- so during that gap it shows the empty-state message, not the skeleton.

Fix: change line 12 to `const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);`. Do not change anything else in this hook -- the existing effect already sets `loading` to `false` only in its `finally` block (line 84) once the fetch settles (or immediately if `isLoaded` is already true on mount, e.g. for a returning authenticated user, where behavior is unaffected). No changes needed in GamesByDateClient.tsx -- its render logic is already correct once `loading` starts `true`.

title: Web: guest default city, alias normalization, fix stuck city-rail loading
description:
Confirmed bug (P0-3 on web): in `useGamesByCity.ts`, the "fetch user city" effect (lines 35-59) does `if (!isLoaded || initialCity) return; if (!user) return;` -- for a guest (`user` is null) it returns without ever calling `setDisplayedCity`. The "fetch games" effect (lines 62-91) does `if (!displayedCity) return;` -- so for guests neither effect runs and `loading` (initialized `true` at line 13) never flips to `false`: guests see an infinite spinner in the 'משחקים ב...' rail forever. There is also a duplicated hardcoded fallback literal `"תל אביב-יפו"` at lines 51 and 54.

Fix `next_app/src/hooks/useGamesByCity.ts`:
1. Replace the "Fetch User City" effect (lines 35-59) so that when `isLoaded && !initialCity`:
   - If `user` exists: keep the existing fetch-user-profile-city logic as-is (lines 40-58), but change both fallback literals (`"תל אביב-יפו"` at lines 51 and 54) to a `DEFAULT_CITY` constant (see below) instead of the inline literal.
   - If `user` is null (guest): fetch `` `${API_BASE}/api/fields/cities/top` `` (added in task 1 of this plan) and `setDisplayedCity(data.city || DEFAULT_CITY)`; on any fetch error, `setDisplayedCity(DEFAULT_CITY)`. This must run for guests too (remove the `if (!user) return;` early exit), so the fetch-games effect always eventually gets a non-empty `displayedCity` and `loading` resolves to `false`.
2. Add `const DEFAULT_CITY = "תל אביב-יפו";` near the top of the file (module scope) and use it in both places instead of the repeated literal.
3. Add a small city-alias normalizer so `"תל אביב"` and `"תל אביב-יפו"` are treated as the same city (per backlog P0-3 "normalized Hebrew city catalog with aliases"): add `const CITY_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = { "תל אביב": "תל אביב-יפו", "Tel Aviv": "תל אביב-יפו", "Tel Aviv-Yafo": "תל אביב-יפו" };` and a `normalizeCity(c: string) { return CITY_ALIASES[c] || c; }` helper, applied to `displayedCity` inside the `predicate` callback (line 19-22, use `normalizeCity(displayedCity)` and `normalizeCity(game.city)` before comparing) and when setting `displayedCity` from any source (server profile city, top-city endpoint, or manual selection).

Fix `next_app/src/components/GamesByCityClient.tsx` (per P0-3's explicit UI ask: "visible chip/button: 'מציג משחקים ב[שם עיר] • שנה עיר'"): the component already has an edit-city `IconButton` + `Dialog` (lines 39-47, 120-155) but it's a small icon, not a prominent labeled chip. Replace the `customHeaderAction` `IconButton` at lines 120-124 with a `Chip` (MUI `Chip`, `clickable`, `onClick={handleEditClick}`) labeled `` `מציג משחקים ב${displayedCity} • שנה עיר` `` placed above or beside the `GamesHorizontalList` title -- keep `handleEditClick`/the existing `Dialog` (lines 136-155) unchanged, only swap the trigger element and its visual prominence.

title: Mobile: fix hardcoded English city fallback and stuck loading
description:
Same bug family as task 3, confirmed in the mobile app: `mobile_app/src/hooks/useGamesByCity.ts:54,57` fall back to the literal English string `'Tel Aviv'` (not `'תל אביב-יפו'` like the web hook) -- since field/game `city` values in the DB are Hebrew, this fallback never matches anything, guests see 0 results. Additionally the same guest-stuck-loading bug as task 3 exists here: the "fetch user city" effect (lines 39-63) does `if (!userId) return;` (line 41) so for guests `displayedCity` never gets set and the fetch-games effect (lines 65-98) never runs, leaving `loading` (initialized `true`, line 15) stuck forever.

Fix:
1. Add `const DEFAULT_CITY = 'תל אביב-יפו';` at module scope and replace both `'Tel Aviv'` literals (lines 54 and 57) with `DEFAULT_CITY`.
2. Change the "fetch user city" effect (lines 39-63) so that when `isLoaded && !initialCity` and `userId` is falsy (guest), it calls `fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/fields/cities/top`)` (new endpoint added in task 1) and does `setDisplayedCity(data.city || DEFAULT_CITY)`, falling back to `DEFAULT_CITY` on any error -- mirror the try/catch shape already used for the authenticated-user branch (lines 45-59) so both paths resolve `displayedCity` and unstick `loading`.
3. Add the same city-alias normalization as task 3 (`CITY_ALIASES`/`normalizeCity`, covering `'תל אביב'`, `'Tel Aviv'`, `'Tel Aviv-Yafo'` -> `'תל אביב-יפו'`) applied in the `predicate` callback (lines 19-22).

Do not touch `mobile_app/src/components/GamesByCitySection.tsx` in this task -- it only consumes `displayedCity`/`loading` from the hook and needs no changes for this fix (no UI chip requirement was raised for mobile in the backlog, unlike web task 3).

description:
Preparatory step for P0-6 (public/open badges on game cards). Confirmed gap: `isFriendsOnly` exists on the shared `Game` type (shared/types/game.ts:71) and is already returned for single-game detail (`mapGameForClient`, gameService.js:154), but is NOT included in `SEARCH_GAME_SELECT` (gameService.js:205-237) nor returned by `mapGameForSearchClient` (gameService.js:239-290) -- so list/rail/search game cards (which all go through `fetchMappedListGames` -> `mapGameForSearchClient`) cannot currently render a public/friends-only badge; the field simply isn't in the payload.

1. Add `isFriendsOnly: true,` to `SEARCH_GAME_SELECT` (gameService.js:205-237), anywhere alongside the other top-level boolean fields (e.g. next to `isOpenToJoin: true,` at line 223).
2. Add `isFriendsOnly: !!game.isFriendsOnly,` to the object returned by `mapGameForSearchClient` (gameService.js:250-289), following the same `!!` boolean-coercion style already used for it in `mapGameForClient` (line 154) -- place it near `isOpenToJoin: game.isOpenToJoin,` (line 274).

Note all list results guests can already see are filtered to `isFriendsOnly === false` (or currently-unlocked) by `buildVisibilityWhere` (gameService.js:318-326), so this is purely additive data exposure for the badge UI in the next task, not a visibility/security change.

title: Web: allow pinch-zoom (accessibility)
description:
Per P3-2 of the backlog (found opportunistically while reading this file for the P1-4 Clerk task): `next_app/src/app/layout.tsx:28-35` sets `export const viewport: Viewport = { ... maximumScale: 1, userScalable: false, ... };`, which disables pinch-to-zoom app-wide -- a real accessibility regression for low-vision users, and against WCAG 1.4.4 (zoom must not be disabled).

Remove the `maximumScale: 1` and `userScalable: false` lines from the `viewport` export (lines 28-35), keeping `themeColor`, `width: "device-width"`, `initialScale: 1`, and `viewportFit: "cover"` unchanged.

description:

Web: localize Clerk's auth UI to Hebrew/RTL
description:
Per P1-4: confirmed `@clerk/localizations` is not installed (`next_app/package.json:15` lists only `"@clerk/nextjs": "^6.31.3"`, no `@clerk/localizations` anywhere in the file or in any import in the codebase) and `next_app/src/app/layout.tsx:62` (`<ClerkProvider {...(clerkProxyUrl ? { proxyUrl: clerkProxyUrl } : {})}>`) passes no `localization` prop -- Clerk's own SignIn/SignUp modal (`SignInButton mode="modal"`, used throughout the app) renders in English inside this RTL-`dir` Hebrew app.

1. Do NOT hand-pin a version in `package.json` -- `@clerk/localizations` ships its own major-version releases (4.x at time of writing) independent of `@clerk/nextjs`'s versioning, and guessing a compatible range risks installing an incompatible major. Instead, from `next_app/` run:
```bash
npm install @clerk/localizations
```
then open `next_app/package.json` and confirm the dependency was added (next to `"@clerk/nextjs": "^6.31.3"` at line 15) with whatever version npm actually resolved -- do not manually edit the version range afterward. This updates `package-lock.json` too; do not skip this step or the build will fail on the new import.
2. In `next_app/src/app/layout.tsx`: add `import { heIL } from "@clerk/localizations";` near the existing `import { ClerkProvider } from "@clerk/nextjs";` (line 6), and pass it to the provider: `<ClerkProvider {...(clerkProxyUrl ? { proxyUrl: clerkProxyUrl } : {})} localization={heIL}>`. Clerk's modal components already respect the page's `dir` via their own internal RTL detection once localized with `heIL` (Clerk's localization object includes `dir` metadata) -- no separate `dir="rtl"` wrapper is needed around `ClerkProvider` itself since `<html dir="rtl">` (line 63) already establishes RTL for the whole document, including Clerk's portal-rendered modal.
After this change, manually verify (or note for the verification pass) that the `SignInButton mode="modal"` flow (e.g. via the `/games/new` guest gate) shows Hebrew labels and right-to-left layout in the modal.

title: Web: guest sticky join CTA and organizer-actions accordion on the game details page
description:
Per P1-7 (partial -- the full "elevate crucial info hierarchy" re-layout is intentionally out of scope for this task, see note at the end). Confirmed current structure in `next_app/src/app/games/[id]/page.tsx:107-193`: no guest-specific CTA exists anywhere on this page today (a guest just sees the same `GameLiveSection` header with the normal `JoinGameButton`, which itself already handles the signed-out case via its own internal Clerk gating -- do not duplicate that logic, only add a visibility affordance); organizer-only management (`GameDetailsEditor` + `Divider` + `SeriesManager`, lines 156-188) renders as three always-visible page-level blocks (each individually opens its own MUI `Dialog` on click, so no internal changes are needed to those two components).

1. **Guest sticky CTA**: IMPORTANT -- `next_app/src/components/BottomNav.tsx` is `position: "fixed", bottom: 0, zIndex: (t) => t.zIndex.appBar` (confirmed, lines 48-52) with a 64px-tall bar, visible on mobile only (`display: { xs: "block", md: "none" }`, line 53); its height is exposed as the CSS var `--bottom-nav-height: 64px` (confirmed in `next_app/src/app/globals.css:27`). A naive `position: "sticky", bottom: 0` on mobile would render UNDERNEATH that bar and be invisible/unreachable -- do not use a plain `bottom: 0`. `userId` is already computed at line 88 (`const userId = authUserId || "";`). After the `<Box mb={4}>...</Box>` block (i.e. as a sibling right before the closing `</Container>` at line 192), add:
```tsx
{!userId && (
  <Box
    sx={{
      position: "sticky",
      bottom: { xs: "calc(var(--bottom-nav-height) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))", md: 0 },
      zIndex: (t) => t.zIndex.appBar - 1,
      mt: 3,
      py: 1.5,
      px: 2,
      bgcolor: "background.paper",
      borderTop: 1,
      borderColor: "divider",
      display: "flex",
      alignItems: "center",
      justifyContent: "center",
      gap: 2,
    }}
  >
    <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={600}>התחבר כדי להצטרף למשחק</Typography>
    <SignInButton mode="modal"><Button variant="contained" size="small">התחבר</Button></SignInButton>
  </Box>
)}
```
Add imports: `import Typography from "@mui/material/Typography";`, `import Button from "@mui/material/Button";`, `import { SignInButton } from "@clerk/nextjs";` (check `Typography`/`Button` aren't already imported first -- this is a Server Component file, but `SignInButton` and other Clerk client components can still be rendered from a Server Component as long as they're used as plain JSX, same as `GameLiveSection` already being a client component rendered here). Note this bar duplicates what `JoinGameButton` already shows inline in the header for a guest -- that's intentional (a persistent affordance while scrolling), not a bug; verify in the browser at a mobile viewport width that the bar sits fully above `BottomNav`, not behind it.
2. **Organizer actions accordion**: wrap the existing `GameDetailsEditor` + `Divider` + `SeriesManager` block (lines 156-188) in a MUI `Accordion` shown only when `canManageSeries` is true, collapsed by default, labeled "ניהול המשחק": `{canManageSeries && (<Accordion sx={{ mt: 2 }}><AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>ניהול המשחק</AccordionSummary><AccordionDetails><GameDetailsEditor .../><Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} /><SeriesManager .../></AccordionDetails></Accordion>)}` -- move the existing `GameDetailsEditor`/`Divider`/`SeriesManager` JSX (with all their current props unchanged) inside this structure exactly as-is, just re-indented/re-parented; do not change any of their props. `GameDetailsEditor`/`SeriesManager` already internally check `canManage`/`canManage` props and render nothing when false, so gating the accordion itself on `canManageSeries` too is intentionally redundant-but-safe (avoids an empty accordion header for non-managers, matching how it renders today where these components already silently no-op for non-managers). Add imports: `import Accordion from "@mui/material/Accordion";`, `import AccordionSummary from "@mui/material/AccordionSummary";`, `import AccordionDetails from "@mui/material/AccordionDetails";`, `import ExpandMoreIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore";`.

Note for future work (do not attempt in this task): the backlog's broader ask to "elevate crucial info (date, time, venue address, price, navigation button) alongside attendee list" would mean restructuring `GameLiveSection.tsx`'s internal layout and/or moving `GameActions.tsx`'s map/navigate button up near the header -- `GameLiveSection.tsx` is the single live-state owner for join/leave/chat per `server/docs/agents/frontend_rules.md` §1.3, so that re-layout deserves its own dedicated, carefully-scoped task rather than being folded into this one.
